 Male 
 07 Nov 26 / 12:47 
 Vanoli: "We must always play for the shirt"
 Paolo Vanoli held a press conference on Saturday ahead of Fiorentina's home game against Juventus on Sunday evening. Below you can read a selection of the coach's comments.
 JUVENTUS - “Of course this is the match for Fiorentina but our aim is always to show what Fiorentina is about. That's what I explain to my players. I've always promised hard work and to give everything on the field – and that's what we do in every game. For our fans and for Florence, this is a special match. But in every match it's important to play for the shirt we wear.”
 FAGIOLI - “You all know what I think of Nicolo. He just needs to stay calm and focus on his football and on Fiorentina.”
 ATTA - “We've further increased his workload but he won't be involved tomorrow.”
 RANIERI - “He trained with the team for part of the session yesterday. I hope to have him available for the bench.”
 PONGRACIC - “Marin is making huge strides forward.”
 OULAI - “Christ needs to keep doing what he's doing.”
 PEDRO GONCALVES - “He's shown his ability. He came on against Sassuolo and made the difference. He's an example for the younger players to follow. Let's not make an issue of it. We're Fiorentina and we have to win our games.”
